name: Your Kiss Is Sweetly Sour
source:
A visual novel about hope and the fact that it's worth fighting for love to the end. Recently, it seemed impossible to be trapped alone with a sweet and kind guy, but now it is.

And now so many questions come to mind...

What to do if you find yourself stranded on a deserted island with the guy of your dreams?

You're wondering if it's all real, and he just hugs you and reassures you, allaying your worries.
He is sweet and kind to you because he cares about you.

Before, there was only grayness and the sadness of loneliness, but now this loving guy is by your side, and you realize that you don't want to part with this feeling. The feeling of your own importance, the feeling of being in love...

But how can you experience all these feelings without pain and fear?

If all your life the desire to hide was stronger. You could only run away from your feelings, but now...

When love touches a lonely and depressed heart, can it heal the pain of the soul?

The only thing that remains is hope. Hope and an irresistible desire to fight for love and for him.
